Wednesday 21 October 2026 · 24 stories
Morning Brief
Nifty 50 fell 1.11% to 22,889 and decliners led 2,028 to 514
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +0.89% weighted by turnover, against -1.55% for the median stock, a gap of 2.5 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

Le Travenues Technology Limited rose 8.7% on 93 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about guidance or investor update, “Investor Presentation”.

Just Dial Limited rose 2.6% on 120 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Prestige Estates has Rs 40,000 crore worth of homes lined up for launch in just six months”.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in Gallantt Ispat Limited (260x), Platinum Industries Limited (195x), Jai Corp Limited (178x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.

33 stocks sit at 52-week lows against 4 at highs. New lows outnumbering new highs this clearly is usually a late signal, not an early one.

Brent crude holds near five-month high on Middle East tension
Brent crude crossed 110 dollars per barrel, sustaining elevated levels on supply disruption risks in the Middle East. Higher crude inflates India's oil import bill, weakening the rupee and raising raw material costs for paint, tyre, and specialty chemical producers. State upstream explorers ONGC and Oil India benefit from wider realisations, whereas oil marketing companies face immediate marketing margin compression unless retail fuel prices rise.

OECD: Chinese reactor designs lead global nuclear pipeline - Asian Power
OECD data shows Chinese nuclear reactor designs now comprise the largest share of the global construction pipeline. This development does not reach Indian equities, as India relies entirely on sovereign procurement and domestic technology partners such as Larsen and Toubro, BHEL, and MTAR Technologies for its fleet expansion. International design adoption elsewhere leaves Indian nuclear equipment manufacturing order books and domestic procurement schedules unchanged.

Surging hyperscale capacity expansion directly supports order books for listed MEP contractors and cooling equipment manufacturers, notably Blue Star and Voltas, alongside electrical distribution suppliers like Schneider Electric Infrastructure. Sustained data centre additions in southern hubs also build a pipeline of yielding commercial real estate assets for eventual REIT packaging.

China restricted exports of specialized tunnel boring machines, prompting the government to propose a $1.2 billion incentive package for domestic manufacturers. Reliance Jio is targeting a valuation of 10 lakh crore rupees by positioning its operations as an integrated technology platform rather than a pure-play telecom utility. Realizing this premium multiple requires higher revenue contributions from enterprise cloud, fixed wireless broadband, and digital services rather than basic tariff hikes alone. Fed to skip October but raise rates again in December, nearly all economists say
A consensus of economists expects the US Federal Reserve to pause in October before delivering a final rate hike in December. An extended terminal rate cycle keeps the yield spread between US Treasuries and Indian sovereign paper compressed, capping foreign institutional inflows into domestic equities. The stance also constrains the Reserve Bank of India from easing domestic liquidity or cutting the repo rate before early next year.

Fed sneezes, but emerging markets aren't catching a cold yet: McGeever
Emerging market balance sheets and elevated real yields are buffering local economies against higher US interest rates, preventing sudden capital flight. India benefits directly through positive real policy rates and record foreign exchange reserves, insulating domestic banking liquidity and credit growth. Sustained resilience protects the valuation premium of the Nifty 50 over broader emerging market indices, provided crude prices do not breach fiscal tolerances.

Reliance Jio opened its 270 billion rupee initial public offering today, marking India's largest equity issue to date. The transaction establishes a clear enterprise valuation benchmark for the telecom sector, directly influencing market pricing for rival Bharti Airtel and parent Reliance Industries. Anchor book allocations and institutional subscription rates will determine the scale of domestic liquidity absorbed from secondary markets.

Contemporary Amperex Technology reported third-quarter profit growth slowed to 26%, pressured by intense domestic price competition. Prolonged price erosion among Chinese battery makers reduces cell import costs for Indian electric vehicle manufacturers Tata Motors and TVS Motor, protecting their vehicle gross margins. Conversely, cheaper imported cells challenge the economic viability of domestic battery manufacturing projects underway at Exide Industries and Amara Raja.

Bank of Japan may raise inflation forecast, stand pat on rates, sources say
The Bank of Japan indicated it will keep interest rates unchanged while raising its near-term inflation projections. Avoiding an immediate rate increase halts further unwinding of the global yen carry trade, reducing sudden capital flight risks for emerging markets like India. The pause stabilizes foreign institutional investor flows into large-cap Indian equities and relieves near-term depreciation pressure on the rupee.

SpaceX Q3 revenue soars 161% YoY on AI business growth, beating estimates
SpaceX reported a 161% year-on-year third-quarter revenue increase, powered by rapid Starlink subscriber growth and AI data services. Accelerating satellite constellation deployments expands global supply-chain opportunities for Indian precision engineering exporters such as MTAR Technologies and Astra Microwave. Starlink's expanding satellite footprint also increases eventual broadband competition for Bharti Airtel and Reliance Jio in rural and enterprise connectivity.

Super Micro Computer projected strong quarterly revenue, citing accelerated enterprise orders for liquid-cooled artificial intelligence servers. Elevated global spending on computing hardware continues to crowd out corporate budgets for discretionary software services, delaying a broad demand recovery for Indian IT majors like Infosys and Wipro. Locally, sustained server investment supports order visibility for domestic high-performance computing hardware manufacturers such as Netweb Technologies.

HDFC Bank has green shoots beyond Q2
HDFC Bank's net interest margin fell to a 12-quarter low in the second quarter, even as asset quality improved and core operating profit expanded. The margin compression stems from sticky post-merger funding costs, prompting a shift toward higher-yielding retail loans to support net interest spreads. Track deposit accretion in the third quarter to confirm whether funding costs have peaked.

Reliance Industries is preparing to list Jio Platforms, which carries 533 million telecom subscribers but trails Bharti Airtel in average revenue per user. A listing will establish a standalone market valuation for its digital assets, narrowing the parent company's holding discount and clarifying capital return metrics. Watch upcoming quarterly ARPU prints across telecom operators to verify whether recent tariff hikes translate into structural margin expansion.
